summary.text: One of the three named Erinyes — Alecto, Tisiphone and Megaera — whom Apollodorus and Hyginus count among the Furies born from the castrated sky's blood on Earth.

story.text: Apollodorus names Megaera among the Furies who rose when the bloody drops of flowing blood from the castrated Uranus fell upon Gaia. Hyginus's preface lists Megaera between Alecto and Tisiphone among the offspring of Aether and Terra, a rival parentage. The pursuit of kin-slayers and oath-breakers belongs to the Erinyes together; Megaera is one of those named in both rolls.
